name: Aave V3 Pool (Arbitrum)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a delay with a bypass, or one not ruled out

narrative.summary: Same BGD Labs Aave Governance V3 pattern as the Ethereum L1 and Base deployments, real 1-day delay - plus a live cross-chain finding: its GOVERNANCE_GUARDIAN Safe shares the identical 9 owners at 5-of-9 with Base’s own Aave guardian Safe.
narrative.detail: $489.2M supplied, the largest Arbitrum TVL scouted. The guardian committee comparison is against a dated 2026-09-17 snapshot of Base’s owner set (re-verified via a dedicated script, not on every push) - a CREATE2-redeployed shared committee, the same pattern this project’s sister research (multisig-overlap) already documented for ether.fi/Curve, found live here for the first time in this project’s own tracked targets.
